name: MeetGeek
tagline: MeetGeek automatically records and transcribes meetings, then uses AI to generate summaries, extract highlights, and track topics across time. It integrates with Slack, Notion, HubSpot, and 2,000+ apps via Zapier. Sales teams, recruiters, and managers use it to keep stakeholders informed without attending every call.
